newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Gazprom, Ruhrgas eye Lithuania Gas offer-report.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom, Ruhrgas eye Lithuania Gas offer-report.

text.p: Lithuanian state-owned gas firm Lietivos Dujos (Lithuania Gas) plans to make an international share offer, which is being eyed by Russia's Gazprom and Germany's Ruhrgas, newspaper Verslo Zinios said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said the company was expected to offer 66 million of its shares at a nominal one litas each, boosting its capital to 399.8 million litas.

The company, which could not immediately be contacted for comment, will announce the conditions of the tender at a December 3 shareholders meeting, the newspaper quoted technical department information head Skirmantas Junevicius as saying.
He told the newspaper that two major foreign companies would be able to take seven percent of the share capital each.
"We are mostly interested in (gas) suppliers, however the shares will be bought by those who are ready to pay more," he was quoted as saying.
Gazprom has already bought a stake in the gas companies of Lithuania's neighbour, Latvia, and northernmost Baltic state, Estonia.
Gazprom is owed around $36 million for gas supplied to Lithuania.
